text:
Mike: quick heads-up — planning to toggle speculative_decoding=v2 on runtime kernels for a small canary this afternoon. target: 5% of inference traffic across p4d-prod (customers tagged only).
Sana: @Mike what's the exact metric set you'll watch? latency p50/p95, error-rate, hallucination-rate? :eyes:
Mike: p50/p95, token throughput, kv_cache hit-rate, and model-quality regression via our prompt set A/B job (eval id: eval-2026-03-15-7).
Kevin: what's the fallback if we see >5% latency regressions or quality drop? auto-disable or manual rollback?
Mike: auto-fallback policy = disable toggle if 3 consecutive 10-min windows show p95 > baseline+200ms OR quality delta > 2% negative. manual alert to #eng-runtime and paging to oncall.
Irene: canary scope = customers with tag "canary-opt" + internal traffic only. avoid high-SLA tenants. ack?
Alex: pushed the toggle PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/812 — rollout jobs and canary tagging included. CI green.
deploy-bot: deploy plan created: kernel-toggle/spec-decode-v2 — staged to canary pool at 18:00 UTC. backup plan: pin to previous kernel variant and immediate rollback hook.
Sana: can we get a quick instrumentation snippet for kv cache and decoder behavior to add to dashboards? prefer simple Prom queries.
Mike: prometheus suggestions (copy into dashboard):
```
avg_over_time(request_latency_seconds{kernel="spec-decoder-v2"}[5m])
(sum(kv_cache_hits{env="prod"})/sum(kv_cache_requests{env="prod"}))
```
Kevin: also add `runtime.kernel.error_rate` filtered by model and seq_len>512. keep an eye on OOM-like spikes.
Irene: QA please run smoke suite `smoke/spec-decode-v2` against canary pool and post failures here.
Alex: ran smoke locally — 3 intermittent failures on long-seq tests, logs attached to PR. looks like kv cache warmup timing may be the cause.
Mike: if flaky long-seq failures persist, hold rollout. For now I'm reducing canary to 2% and re-run smoke. updating PR.
Sana: ack. I'll add alert thresholds (p95 > baseline+150ms, quality delta >1.5%) and a short runbook in PR description.
QA-bot: smoke/spec-decode-v2: 95% passed; 3 flaky tests — details: https://ci.redwood/smoke/785
Kevin: pinged @infra to reserve extra p4d capacity during canary window in case of rollback traffic spikes.
Mike: closing loop — updated rollout window to 18:30-19:00 UTC, canary=2%, auto-fallback enabled. I will post final go/no-go at 18:15 UTC.
Sana: thanks! :thumbsup:
Alex: standing by for rollback if needed.
Mike: will also coordinate a follow-up re-run with KV warmup tweak if we hit the flakes. timeline: follow-up in next 24h.
Sana: adding a small doc snippet to the PR about how to flip the flag manually (curl + auth) and how to revert.
Alex: manual flip example (for oncall):
```
curl -X POST https://flags.redwood/api/v1/toggles/speculative_decoding -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"value": "v2", "audience": "canary-opt", "percent": 2}'
```
Mike: perfect. thanks everyone — will update when the plan is live.
